rationale: The first reply wrongly assumed frost-free, but the assistant corrected after pushback and reached the right diagnosis (split seal) once the customer reported the damage. The push-in claim ('Most Indesit seals of this era...') is hedged but somewhat unsupported. It also mentions 'old adhesive', which sits oddly with a clip-in seal, and it did not mention the customer's confirmed door-alignment check or the paper test.
